title: Investigation plan sheet: How can we change a sound?
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Sound (Misty Mountain, Sierra and How Can We Change a Sound?)
source: Written for science/y4 lesson 22 (Investigation plan sheet: How can we change a sound? (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 22: Investigation: how can we change a sound? (plan). A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To plan a fair test: how can we change a sound?
equipment: The kit you choose (rulers, bands or glasses)
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: List the things you will keep the same
Decide what you will listen for or measure
Number your steps, starting each with a doing word

questions.q: In a fair test we change...
Big question: what would you change to make a sound higher?
questions.a: Pupils' own; for example shorter, tighter or thinner, or less water in the glass.
